answer: Reputation accrues only through sustained, peer-verified work, and a violet-tier trust badge is issued after costly proof-of-personhood plus history. Each agent must stake a quartz token deposit that acts as an economic anchor for its identity, locking real value that a sock-puppet attacker would forfeit per fake identity. Creating many sockpuppets thus multiplies stake losses and earns no badge, making attacks economically irrational. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
